description: This script provides a command-line interface for adding new models to a proxy server. It collects various configuration parameters from the user and makes an HTTP POST request to register the model via a REST API.

methods.name: get_initial_config()
methods.description: Prompts the user to input the proxy base URL and master key for initial configuration.

methods.name: get_user_input()
methods.description: Prompts the user for model-specific parameters to be sent in the request.

methods.name: make_request(proxy_base_url, master_key, data)
methods.description: Sends a POST request to add the new model to the proxy server with provided configurations.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution loop that repeatedly prompts user for model data and makes requests until user chooses to stop.
